value.rationale: The 2023 founding paper specifically identifies theoretical dynamics with multiple independent clubs as an open direction. Exact ordinal payoff laws for any number of clubs and a complete global basin decomposition for a fixed arbitrary club count give a structural answer rather than a routine numerical case. The theorem sharply distinguishes true winners from measure-zero tied-saddle coexistence, quantifies free-agent elimination and provides all \(2^K\) equilibrium stability types and exponential rates. These details are natural for resource-allocation coalition competition and are not supplied by a simple one-club formula.
